description: The chart represents the distribution of various analysis categories in a circular pie chart. The chart is divided into 17 slices, each representing a distinct category. The slices are labeled with different analysis types, such as "Content Analysis", "Semantic Layer" (41.2%), "Cultural Layer" (14.1%), and "Signal Layer" (4.3%), and are colored in different shades of blue, with darker shades generally representing larger proportions. The chart does not include a legend, but some slices have percentage labels. The slices appear to be ordered in a way that the larger categories are positioned at the bottom and right side of the chart, while the smaller ones are at the top. Some categories are further sub-divided into smaller sub-categories, such as "Content Analysis" being divided into "Semantic Layer", "Emotion & Intention", and "Speaker Analysis". The chart visually emphasizes certain categories through the use of darker shades, but no slices are exploded or offset.
